hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-pricing, an internal service owned by checkout-platform, began taking about 1500ms per basket-total call at 15:58. The account page waits on it, so p50, p95 and p99 all jumped. io-shop itself is healthy: nothing was deployed or changed, and CPU, memory and error rate are flat.

supporting_evidence.claim: WARN io-shop: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-10306-3-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
43 of 200 requests slow at onset, then 200 of 200 (ramp-in)
get_changes: nothing changed in the 24h window before onset
p50 went from 45 to 1546ms and p95 to 1721ms, with flat error rate, CPU and memory
The service register lists io-pricing as internal, owned by checkout-platform, at pricing.io-internal.svc
